senses.gloss: (as in Hebr. a. Syr.) to stir up, make turbid.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 30:14">Targ. Is. XXX, 14</cite> ed. (ed. Lag. <he>זלח</he>, h. text <he>חשף</he>) a sherd with which <he>למִדְלַח מיא וכ׳</he> to stir up some water out of a (dried up) pool.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:25">Targ. Job III, 25</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 27:1">Targ. Ps. XXVII, 1</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 38:25">Targ. Job XXXVIII, 25</cite> <he>דלח</he> Ms., ed. <cite ref="D00800"><he>דְּלָא</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 4:14">Targ. Job IV, 14</cite> <he>דַּלֵּיחַ</he> Buxt. (some ed. a. Ms. <cite ref="D00825"><he>דְּלִיחַ</he></cite>).—
